name: who-dat public instance (who-dat.as93.net)
operator: Alicia Sykes (individual developer, as93.net), author of the MIT-licensed who-dat project; the public instance is hosted on Vercel
tier_rationale: P343 FC2: 'The public who-dat.as93.net instance is a separate module whois_fallback_public: unknown tier, default_enabled=False, excluded at AMBER and above' (individual operator, no published terms or privacy policy for the hosted service). Live 2026-11-26: answers come from a shared CDN cache (cache-control public, x-vercel-cache HIT with age), so a lookup is observable through cache state. CLEAR/GREEN only with --allow-unknown (A8).

reliability.justification: Registry RDAP/WHOIS data relayed and normalised by a best-effort public instance; answers may be served from its cache (meta.cached) and a subdomain query is answered for the registrable domain.

whodat.title: who-dat public lookup GET https://who-dat.as93.net/<domain>: normalised registration data (meta.source rdap|whois, meta.server)

terms.quote: Default module tier trusted (IANA and registries), terms open.

whodat.notes: Quote: binding council text (P343 chair rationale: the proposal's terms class is 'open'); research record C0785: 'MIT (code); data from registries' RDAP/WHOIS', public instance 'best effort'. The MIT licence covers the code; the hosted instance publishes no separate terms, so legal may still tighten this class (doctor --licences review queue). Only IOC values (domain names) are ever sent (A8 unknown tier); contact values are dropped at ingestion (P343 FC4).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G01-4 (P343 module whois_fallback_public, opt-in). Best-effort public instance: 2 s between requests, 100 lookups/day (module daily_quota), 24 h cache.
